name: Shiprocket Login
author: Shiprocket Limited

sections.description:
Shiprocket Login enables passwordless customer authentication for WooCommerce stores using mobile number verification.

Customers can log in using their verified mobile number without requiring a password. The plugin automatically creates or identifies WooCommerce customer accounts and provides a simplified login experience.

The plugin integrates with Shiprocket Login services to authenticate customers and maintain WooCommerce customer sessions.

Features

  • Mobile number based customer login.
  • Passwordless customer authentication.
  • Shiprocket Login integration.
  • Automatic WooCommerce customer account creation.
  • Existing customer identification using mobile number.
  • Existing customer migration using WooCommerce billing phone number.
  • Support for custom login buttons, links, menu items, and other elements.
  • Configurable login trigger selectors.
  • Customizable login popup theme color.
  • Custom login banner image upload support.
  • HMAC-based API communication.
  • WooCommerce customer session support.
  • No password management required.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher.
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher.
  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • Valid Shiprocket Login API credentials.

External Services

This plugin connects to Shiprocket Login services to authenticate customers and create customer sessions.

It sends the following information when a customer logs in:
* Mobile number
* Store domain
* Authentication request data

It also sends the following information when the store administrator configures the plugin:
* API Key
* API Secret (used locally to generate HMAC signatures)

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/shiprocket-login.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Open the Shiprocket Login settings page from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Enter your Shiprocket API Key and Secret Key.
  6. Configure your login trigger selector(s).
  7. Customize the popup theme color and banner image if required.
  8. Save settings.
sections.faq:
How does customer identification work?

Customers are identified using their verified mobile number. The plugin stores the mobile number in WooCommerce customer metadata and uses it for future logins.

Will existing WooCommerce customers continue to work?

Yes. Existing customers can be matched using their WooCommerce billing phone number and linked with Shiprocket Login.

Does the plugin create new customer accounts automatically?

Yes. If no existing customer account is found, the plugin creates a new WooCommerce customer account.

Can I customize the login popup appearance?

Yes. You can configure the popup theme color and upload a custom banner image from the plugin settings page.

Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated for Shiprocket Login to work.
